description: Manage web-automation robots, tasks, and results with Browse AI. Organize web-data tasks around configured robots and use their results for information preparation, data checks, and subsequent analysis. For data analysts and application developers, this context helps organize work around data objects, structures, and projects. Use the available information to prepare analysis or maintenance work and connect data understanding with development and result review. Available data and operations depend on the current connection configuration, account permissions, and service plan.
description_cn: 通过 Browse AI 管理网页自动化机器人、任务和结果。适合围绕已配置的机器人组织网页数据任务，将任务结果用于资料整理、数据核对和后续分析。面向数据分析与应用开发团队，可围绕数据对象、结构和项目背景组织工作，将相关信息整理为分析或维护依据，衔接数据理解、开发准备与结果复核。具体可用的数据与操作范围以当前连接配置、账号权限及服务套餐为准。
